Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，The location phrase should come before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 does not naturally take an action such as 祭拜 as its object here; 假装 means to pretend to perform an action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，On first mention, introduce the character with both a full noun phrase and a name, rather than assuming the reader already knows who 孟子 is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: reference_form]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at age five, so the last verb in the action phrase takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点状语应放在动作“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达这个意思。
首次出现人物需要先介绍孟子，但改后文字以逗号结束，单独显示并不是完整句子。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按近距离复现规则应使用“他”。
五岁时搬家是已经完成的一次事件，应说“搬了家”。
